column3: NASB follows the critical text; it moves “like a trap” (v. 35) into this verse and renders “burdened” as “weighted down.”
NASB follows the critical text; “as a snare” is moved to v. 34, and “sitting” is rendered “dwell.”
NASB follows the critical text; “watch” is rendered “keep on the alert.”
NASB renders the imperfect “was lodging” as “would … spend the night.”
NASB adds “get up … in the morning.”
